create_quantizer_4bit: create a BnB4BitDiffusersQuantizer instance to quantize a diffusers model to 4-bit using bitsandbytes
create_quantizer_8bit: create a BnB8BitDiffusersQuantizer instance to quantize a diffusers model to 8-bit using bitsandbytes
validate_environment_4bit: validate the environment for 4-bit quantization checking GPU, accelerate, and bitsandbytes availability
process_model_before_loading: process a model before weight loading by replacing linear layers with quantized Linear4bit or Linear8bitLt modules
dequantize_model: dequantize a quantized model by replacing quantized layers back to their original linear layers
